Remark
[The cubic-over-time error] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0310 1. ch24:24.27\group Ricci Flow Characterization

If $r_\tau (x)^2+\tau \to 0$ while $r_\tau (x)^2/\tau $ remains bounded, then $r_\tau (x)^3/\tau \to 0$.
